notes_for_editor: No build date, design, height, staffing or fire history was found in the sources read. The Commons file title says GA216, but tnlandforms assigns GA216 to Fargo (Clinch County) and Baker to GA272. The file's camera position is about 75 m from the Baker coordinates, so the match is likely but not confirmed. The photo url is the Commons file page, not a direct image URL. The brief's register numbers BLL US 41122 and GFC US 209 were not confirmed by the sources read (tnlandforms shows BLL-41122 and gfc-209). The 2006 Savannah Morning News article returned HTTP 403 and was not read.
